section.44: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

44.name_native: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

hadiths.text: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The best women who ride the camels are the pious women of the Quraish; they treat with affection children in their childhood and keep a strict watch on the wealth of their spouses
